tests.experiment: Take 0.1 g of salt and add conc. H₂SO₄
tests.observation: A colourless gas is evolved which gives dense white fumes with ammonia

tests.name: Concentrated H₂SO₄ and MnO₂ Test
tests.experiment: Take a pinch of MnO₂ in salt solution and add 3–4 drops of conc. H₂SO₄, then heat
tests.observation: Greenish yellow chlorine gas is evolved

tests.name: Silver Nitrate Test
tests.experiment: Acidify 1 mL of sodium carbonate extract with dilute HNO₃ (or use water extract) and add AgNO₃ solution
tests.observation: Curdy white precipitate soluble in NH₄OH

tests.name: Chromyl Chloride Test
tests.experiment: Take a little salt with solid K₂Cr₂O₇, add conc. H₂SO₄, heat. Pass the evolved gas through sodium hydroxide solution, divide into two parts. Acidify one part with acetic acid and add lead acetate solution
tests.observation: The sodium hydroxide solution becomes yellow; adding acetic acid and lead acetate gives yellow precipitate of lead chromate

tests.experiment: Take 0.1 g of salt in a test tube and add conc. H₂SO₄ (or add MnO₂ if needed) and warm
tests.observation: Reddish brown fumes of bromine are evolved

tests.name: Layer Test
tests.experiment: Take 1 mL of neutralized extract, add CCl₄/CHCl₃ (or other suitable organic solvent), then add chlorine water dropwise and shake vigorously
tests.observation: Orange-brown colouration appears in the organic layer

tests.name: Silver Nitrate Test
tests.experiment: Acidify sodium carbonate extract with dilute HNO₃ (or use water extract) and add AgNO₃
tests.observation: Pale yellow precipitate

tests.experiment: Take 0.1 g of salt in a test tube and add conc. H₂SO₄
tests.observation: Deep violet vapour with a pungent odour is evolved

tests.name: Layer Test
tests.experiment: Take test solution or extract, add CHCl₃/CCl₄ and chlorine water dropwise, then shake vigorously
tests.observation: Violet colouration appears in the organic layer

tests.name: Silver Nitrate Test
tests.experiment: Acidify sodium carbonate extract with dilute HNO₃ and add AgNO₃
tests.observation: Yellow precipitate is obtained, insoluble in excess NH₄OH

tests.experiment: Take the salt and treat with concentrated H₂SO₄
tests.observation: Colourless gas evolves and it etches glass

tests.name: Calcium Chloride Test
tests.experiment: Treat salt solution with calcium chloride solution
tests.observation: White gelatinous precipitate forms

tests.experiment: If no earlier anion test is positive, acidify the extract with dilute HCl and add BaCl₂ solution
tests.observation: White precipitate of barium sulphate, insoluble in conc. HCl or conc. HNO₃ is obtained

tests.name: Lead Acetate Test
tests.experiment: Acidify the solution with acetic acid and add lead acetate solution
tests.observation: White precipitate appears

tests.name: Preliminary Test
tests.experiment: Add conc. H₂SO₄ to the solution and boil with a few copper turnings/chips
tests.observation: On heating, brown fumes (NO₂) are evolved in excess and the solution becomes blue

tests.name: Brown Ring Test
tests.experiment: Take 1 mL of salt solution, add 2 mL conc. H₂SO₄, cool, then add freshly prepared ferrous sulphate solution along the sides
tests.observation: Brown ring is formed at the junction of the two solutions

tests.experiment: Take 0.1 g of salt, add 1–2 mL of dilute H₂SO₄
tests.observation: Colourless odourless gas is evolved with brisk effervescence; lime water turns milky

tests.name: Lime Water Test
tests.experiment: Pass the gas through lime water
tests.observation: Lime water turns milky; milkiness disappears on passing excess gas (soluble calcium bicarbonate)

tests.experiment: Warm the salt with dilute H₂SO₄
tests.observation: Colourless gas with smell of rotten eggs is evolved

tests.name: Lead Acetate Test
tests.experiment: Pass gas through filter paper dipped in lead acetate solution
tests.observation: Paper turns black

tests.name: Sodium Nitroprusside Test
tests.experiment: Make solution alkaline with NH₄OH (or sodium carbonate extract) and add sodium nitroprusside solution
tests.observation: Purple/violet colouration is produced

tests.experiment: Warm 1 mL of water extract or sodium carbonate extract with dilute H₂SO₄
tests.observation: Colourless gas with pungent smell of burning sulphur is evolved

tests.name: Barium Chloride Test
tests.experiment: Add barium chloride to water extract or sodium carbonate extract
tests.observation: White precipitate dissolves on adding dilute HCl and SO₂ is evolved

tests.name: KMnO₄ Decolourisation Test
tests.experiment: Add dilute H₂SO₄ to the barium sulphite precipitate and then very dilute KMnO₄ solution
tests.observation: Colour of potassium permanganate solution is discharged

tests.name: Ammonium Molybdate Test
tests.experiment: Acidify with conc. HNO₃ and add ammonium molybdate solution, boil
tests.observation: Canary yellow precipitate is formed

tests.experiment: Warm the solid salt with dilute H₂SO₄
tests.observation: Brown fumes of NO₂ are evolved

tests.name: Potassium Iodide Starch Test
tests.experiment: Take evolved gas and add KI + starch solution acidified with acetic acid
tests.observation: Blue colour appears

tests.name: Sulphanilic Acid / 1-Naphthylamine Test
tests.experiment: Acidify 1 mL of water extract with acetic acid and add sulphanilic acid solution followed by 1-naphthylamine reagent
tests.observation: Red colour is formed

tests.experiment: Universal Indicator
tests.observation: Solution turns blue or purple

tests.name: Phenolphthalein Test
tests.experiment: Add phenolphthalein indicator to salt solution
tests.observation: Solution turns pink

tests.experiment: Take 0.1 g salt + dilute H₂SO₄
tests.observation: Colourless vapours with vinegar-like smell evolve

tests.name: Ester Test
tests.experiment: Take 0.1 g salt in a test tube with ethanol and a little conc. H₂SO₄, then heat
tests.observation: Fruity odour of ethyl acetate is developed

tests.name: Ferric Chloride Test
tests.experiment: Add neutral ferric chloride solution to the salt solution
tests.observation: Deep red colour appears; on heating it disappears and a brown-red precipitate forms

tests.experiment: Take 0.1 g salt and add conc. H₂SO₄
tests.observation: Colourless gases are evolved. On testing further, CO₂ and CO are evolved

tests.name: Calcium Chloride Test
tests.experiment: Acidify extract with acetic acid and add calcium chloride
tests.observation: White precipitate of calcium oxalate is obtained

tests.name: KMnO₄ Test
tests.experiment: Filter and add dilute H₂SO₄ to the precipitate, then dilute KMnO₄ and warm
tests.observation: KMnO₄ pink colour is discharged
